rationale: The agent correctly enforced authentication before attempting any order changes and did not perform any writes without confirmation. It also provided accurate details and pricing for the purple S polyester v‑neck t‑shirt and listed only in‑stock variants later on. However, the very first answer to the user’s initial request (“how many different t-shirt options are available right now”) was incorrect: the tool data shows 12 total variants with 10 available (in stock), but the agent stated 11. This violates the requirement to provide correct final information for the user’s request, so the interaction does not meet the pass bar.
